mn64:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn64:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn64:2.1: Dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave mayā desitāni pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
mn64:2.2: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Māluṅkyāputto Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn64:2.3: Ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi Bhagavatā desitāni pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
mn64:2.4: -Yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ Māluṅkyāputta dhāresi mayā desitāni pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti. --
mn64:2.5: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.6: Vicikicchaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.7: Sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.8: Kāmacchandaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.9: Byāpādaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.10: Evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante dhāremi Bhagavatā desitāni pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
mn64:3.1: Kassa kho nāma tvaṃ Māluṅkyāputta mayā evaṃ pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni desitāni dhāresi.
mn64:3.2: Nanu Māluṅkyāputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissanti :
mn64:3.3: Daharassa hi Māluṅkyāputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sakkāyo ti pi na hoti, kuto pan' assa uppajjissati sakkāyadiṭṭhi; \ [...

mn64:3.5: Daharassa hi Māluṅkyāputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa dhammā ti pi na hoti, kuto. pan' assa uppajjissati dhammesu vicikicchā;
mn64:3.7: Daharassa hi Māluṅkyāputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sīlā ti pi na hoti, kuto pan' assa uppajjissati sīlesu sīlabbataparāmāso;
mn64:3.9: Daharassa hi Māluṅkyāputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāmā ti pi na hoti, kuto pan' assa uppajjissati kāmesu kāmacchando;
mn64:3.11: Daharassa hi Māluṅkyāputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sattā ti pi na hoti, kuto pan' assa uppajjissati sattesu byāpādo;
mn64:3.13: Nanu Māluṅkyāputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissantīti.
mn64:4.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn64:4.2: Etassa Bhagavā kālo, etassa Sugata kālo,
mn64:4.3: yaṃ Bhagavā pañc' orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni deseyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti. --
mn64:4.4: Tena h' Ānanda suṇohi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn64:4.5: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn64:5.1: Idh' Ānanda assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
mn64:5.3: uppannāya ca sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti;
mn64:5.4: tassa sā sakkāyadiṭṭhi thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.6: uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti;
mn64:5.7: tassa sā vicikicchā thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.9: uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti;
mn64:5.10: tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.11: Kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn64:5.12: uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti;
mn64:5.13: tassa so kāmarāgo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.15: uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na-ppajānāti;
mn64:5.16: tassa so byāpādo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:6.1: Sutavā ca kho Ānanda ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto, na sakkāyadiṭṭhipariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na sakkāyadiṭṭhiparetena,

mn64:9.1: Katamo c' Ānanda maggo katamā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya:
mn64:9.2: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:9.3: So yad-eva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
mn64:9.5: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
